verdict.rationale: Better Auth markets 'Auth for AI agents' with MCP auth, token exchange and agent delegation. It documents an MCP plugin that acts as an OAuth authorization server, plus an API Key plugin with expiration, rate limits and organization-owned keys, so agents can be issued their own credentials rather than a human's. However, the evidence never documents narrowly scoped permissions on agent credentials or instant revocation of agent keys or tokens; the only revocation shown is users revoking their own sessions and a homepage activity mockup. Missing for 10: documented per-agent machine identity model, fine-grained permission scoping on agent credentials, explicit instant revocation of agent keys or tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration.
